descriptions.d26h_land_messages_800bab30: Handles land messages: 64 runs the base handler then starts the land (0x800bb114), returning 0x80004005 if the base failed; 66 shuts the land down. Cached ids dispatch to test cell, apply cell, indexed dispatch, map load (XOM extension selects 0x800bc5d0, otherwise 0x800bc350; with no name loads the held map 0x800bc7c4), collision, registry clear, name broadcast and grid rebuild, each posting or falling through to the base handler 0x8015fb34.
